panel.title: Together
panel.intro: Build this with friends. Everyone sees the same bench, and the chat is translated into each person's language.
panel.introPlain: Build this with friends. Everyone sees the same bench, and one person types at a time.
panel.badCode: That isn't a room code. Codes have 6 letters and numbers.
panel.unavailable: This browser can't open rooms. Try a current version of Chrome, Firefox, Safari or Edge.
panel.localOnly: This deployment has no relay server, so rooms work between tabs of this browser only.
panel.syncing: Getting the bench from the host…
panel.reconnecting: Connection lost. Reconnecting… Your changes will sync when you're back.

ended.removed: The host removed you from the room.
ended.full: That room is full. Rooms hold 8 people.
ended.wrong-item: That room is building something else. Open its invite link to join it.

identity.title: Who are you?
identity.hint: People in the room see this name. It stays on this device.
identity.name: Your name
identity.missing: Type the name people in the room will see.

bar.label: Room {code}
bar.inviteHint: Anyone with this link or QR code can join. No account needed.
bar.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it yourself.
bar.shareText: Build with me in iynk, room {code}
bar.qr: QR code for the invite link to room {code}
bar.qrError: Couldn't draw the QR code. Copy the link instead.
bar.denied: {name} has the keyboard. Ask for it to edit the code.

chat.title: Room chat
chat.empty: No messages yet. Say hi, or ask for help with a part.
chat.label: Message
chat.translateOff: Translation isn't set up on this deployment, so messages show as written.
chat.offBoth: Translation and voice messages aren't set up on this deployment, so messages show as written.

voice.off: Voice messages aren't set up on this deployment.
voice.denied: iynk can't use the microphone. Allow it in the browser to send voice messages.
voice.failed: Couldn't transcribe that. Try again, or type it.

cursors.label: Where the others are pointing
cursors.surface: Pointing surface. Move over the figure to show the others where you point. Arrow keys move, Esc stops.

lobby.metaDescription: Open a live build room on any board, robot or drone and build it together.
lobby.title: Nobody has to build alone
lobby.lede: Open a room on any board, robot or drone and send the link. Everyone sees the same bench, one person types at a time, and the chat shows each message in your own language.
lobby.ledePlain: Open a room on any board, robot or drone and send the link. Everyone sees the same bench, and one person types at a time.

create.title: Start a room
create.hint: You get an invite link and a QR code to share.
create.empty: No lab items are ready yet.

join.title: Join a room
join.hint: Type the 6-character code from the invite, or paste the link.
join.empty: Nobody is in room {code} right now. Rooms close 30 minutes after the last person leaves.
join.timeout: Couldn't reach room {code}. Check the code and your connection.
join.unknown: Room {code} is open, but it didn't say what it's building. Ask for the invite link.

buddies.title: Buddies

needsServer.title: Buddies need a server
needsServer.body: Buddies live on an iynk server that you or a friend runs. Without one, this page has nothing to show and the rest of iynk works as before.

insecure.title: This page needs a secure connection
insecure.body: Your browser only makes device keys on https pages or on localhost. Open iynk over https and try again.

list.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from your buddies? You can pair again later.
list.blockConfirm: Block {name}? They are removed and cannot pair with you again.

enrol.title: Join this server
enrol.name: Your name
enrol.closed: This server isn't taking new people right now.
enrol.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Check it, or ask the person who runs the server for a new one.
enrol.help: The person who runs the server gives you a code. It works once.

pair.title: Pair with a buddy
pair.qr: QR code for the pairing link
pair.enterLabel: Code or link from your buddy
pair.wrong: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
pair.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
pair.full: One of you has reached the buddy limit.

unknown.title: This server isn't known here
unknown.body: This browser has no key for that server. Join it with an enrolment code first.

buddies.unreachable: Can't reach the server. Check that it is running and try again.
